title: D-091 T6: review combiner that merges the Codex and Claude reviews into one (model is a setting, unset = refuse; default off)
objective: Add a combiner stage that reads the Codex review and the Claude review of the same frozen head and produces one combined review that can only keep or add findings: every finding either reviewer raised stays unless the combiner cites concrete evidence refuting it; conflicts are resolved only with evidence; every point keeps its source tag; the combined verdict is the worst unrefuted verdict (never FAIL to PASS). The union, source tags and worst-verdict rule are computed in code; the model only proposes evidence-backed refutations, which code accepts only when they cite evidence. The combining model is a required setting with no default (owner choice D-091-R008); unset means the combiner refuses. Behind a switch that defaults off; not wired into the loop.
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.

acceptance_scenarios: primary: two well-formed reviews of the same frozen head give one combined review whose findings are the union, each tagged codex or claude, with the worst unrefuted verdict
boundary: a finding is dropped only when the combiner's refutation cites evidence (file/line, command output or SHA) that code can check is present; an uncited refutation leaves the finding in

never weaker: if either review is FAIL (or has an unrefuted blocking finding) the combined verdict is never PASS; a combined PASS needs both reviews PASS or every blocking finding refuted with evidence
missing/ambiguous: a missing, malformed, empty, timed-out or raised-exception review is treated as FAIL/UNVERIFIED, never PASS; reviews of different heads are refused
independence: the combiner refuses when its identity equals the producer's or either reviewer's
settings: the combining model has no default; unset means the combiner refuses; the switch defaults off and nothing in the loop calls the combiner
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
